measure_pairs — MEASURE1D caliper op

• Data kinds: image2d × measurehandle → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.measure_pairs(image, measure, sigma=1.0, threshold=0.1) (to call the implementation directly, import measuring1d; measuring1d.measure_pairs(image, measure, sigma=1.0, threshold=0.1); from the registry, opsmeasure1d.get("measure_pairs"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Extracts pairs of rising/falling edges (the width of a structure) (measure_pairs). first/second = pos of each edge, width = width [px], first_point/second_point = (row, col).

It returns neither failure nor confidence (an empty list when no pair is found, and pairs even in the danger zone). Once edge spacing / PSF width drops below 3.09 the width is always biased upward (+2.43 px at 2.06), and it keeps answering "pair found" down to 1.58 — measurements and how to watch for this are in "Pitfall 2" of docs/ops/measure1d/guides/subpixel_measuring.md. The polarity order is not checked either (the width of a dark structure can come back; same guide §4). Units are px; when you need mm, pass the result to table_px_to_mm / pixel_to_world.

Empty input (image with 0 elements) raises ValueError.
